PROVIDERS.NATIVE_DESC: Pair a phone through the connector that ships with this installation
PROVIDERS.UAZAPI_DESC: Pair a phone through your own uazapi instance

PROVIDER_URL.LABEL: Provider URL
PROVIDER_URL.PLACEHOLDER: If provider is not running locally, please provide the URL

CLIENT_TOKEN.LABEL: Security Token
CLIENT_TOKEN.PLACEHOLDER: Please enter your Security Token (see Security tab on Z-API dashboard)

EXTERNAL_PROVIDER.SUBTITLE: Click below to setup the WhatsApp channel.

LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.TITLE: Link your device
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.SUBTITLE: Scan the QR code to link your device. Make sure the phone number is correct before scanning.
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.CONNECTED: Your device has been connected successfully. You can now start sending and receiving messages.
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.IMPORT_SESSION_DESC: WhatsApp now requires a passkey when linking some accounts, which blocks the QR code. Install the browser extension to import a session you're already logged into on WhatsApp Web.

BASE_URL.LABEL: Instance URL
BASE_URL.ERROR: Enter the address of your instance

TOKEN.LABEL: Instance token
TOKEN.PLACEHOLDER: Paste the token of the instance you want to use

MARK_AS_READ.LABEL: Mark messages as read on WhatsApp

PRESENCE_SUBSCRIBE.LABEL: Show when the contact is online

CONFIRM.TITLE: Convert inbox provider
CONFIRM.INTRO: You are about to change the WhatsApp provider for '{inboxName}' (currently {currentProvider}). Before continuing, review what will happen:
CONFIRM.EFFECT_DISCONNECT: The current session with {currentProvider} will be disconnected.
CONFIRM.EFFECT_TEMPLATES: Message templates will be cleared and must be resynced on the new provider.
CONFIRM.EFFECT_CONNECTION: Provider connection state will be reset.
CONFIRM.EFFECT_PRESERVED: Conversations, messages, contacts, agent assignments and history are preserved.
CONFIRM.EFFECT_IDENTITY: Inbox name and phone number stay the same.
CONFIRM.CONFIRM_PROMPT: To confirm, type the inbox name below:

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not convert inbox. Please check the credentials and try again.

SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_MANAGE_PROVIDER_CONNECTION_SUBH: Link your device and manage the provider connection.
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_PROVIDER_URL_SUBHEADER: If the provider is not running locally, please provide the URL.
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_MARK_AS_READ_SUBHEADER: If turned off, when a message is viewed in Chatwoot, a read receipt will not be sent to the sender. Your messages will still be able to receive read receipts from the sender.
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_PRESENCE_SUBSCRIBE_SUBHEADER: When enabled, you will see typing indicators in the conversation when a WhatsApp contact is typing or recording audio. Requires reconnecting the channel to take effect.
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_INSTANCE_ID_UPDATE_SUBHEADER: Enter the new Instance ID here
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_TOKEN_UPDATE_SUBHEADER: Enter the new instance Token here
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_CLIENT_TOKEN_SUBHEADER: Your Z-API Client Token (see Security tab on Z-API dashboard).
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_CLIENT_TOKEN_UPDATE_SUBHEADER: Enter the new Security Token here

ASSIGNMENT.PREVENT_TAKEOVER_SUB_TEXT: Once an agent takes a conversation, only they or an administrator can change who is handling it. Automatic assignment is not affected.

EXISTING_TEMPLATE.LABEL: Select template
EXISTING_TEMPLATE.EMPTY_STATE: No compatible templates found. Templates must have a URL button with a dynamic parameter.
EXISTING_TEMPLATE.SYNC_ERROR: Failed to sync templates. Please try again.

TEMPLATE_VARIABLES.TITLE: Template variables
TEMPLATE_VARIABLES.DESCRIPTION: Set values for the template body variables. You can use dynamic variables like {'{{'} contact.name {'}}'} that will be resolved at send time.
TEMPLATE_VARIABLES.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please set all template variables before saving.
